messages:
SARAH: Hey finance/legal, merchant just flagged signing flow for reseller (multi-entity). PO needs net45, but legal redlined MSA + DPA re: subproc. Also SSO/KMS integration pending. Can we map signer chain? :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

RAJ: @sarah can you drop the redlines? if it's the usual subproc clause we can accept with an addendum. who is the counterparty entity?

SARAH: SamCorp US (HQ) + SamCorp EU (sister). They want one PO, two signers depending on region. They asked for a "zipper" signing: two separate sign flows that must both complete to execute. attached the order form draft.

MARTA: Net45 is fine but need AR to confirm invoice entity and tax id. Also approve credit hold T&Cs. FYI pricing discount tied to commitment tier, which changes if EU entity is included.

LEO: From SE: SSO/KMS integration is optional for Hosted. If they need HSM-backed KMS, that's an enterprise add-on. We should offer Dedicated + KMS. Quick sketch:
```
1) PO created -> billing entity resolved
2) If EU entity -> countersign DPA addendum
3) Both signers send e-sign -> contract executes
fallback: if EU signer delays >7d -> auto-failover to escrow flow
```

RAJ: That fallback is tricky legally. We can't auto-fail to escrow without explicit consent. Propose we add a clause: "If countersign delayed >30 days, parties may agree alternate payment routing" — need customer ok.

SARAH: @sam_corp could you confirm acceptance of the fallback clause? Also which entity will handle payments?

sam_corp: Sam (customer): We're fine with 30 days. Payments via SamCorp US for now, EU entity will be billed separately but wants entitlement on the PO. Can we do one purchase order referencing both entities?

MARTA: We can accept single PO referencing both entities but need separate invoices and tax IDs. I'll prepare a billing matrix. Also need PO to match legal name exactly.

RAJ: I'll prepare a DPA addendum for EU entity and update signature matrix. @sarah add me to the countersign loop when doc is ready.

esign-bot: esign request sent to sarah, sam, eu_signer. Link: https://redwood.esign/req/0xabc123 :white_check_mark:

SARAH: Thanks team. Action items:
- @RAJ draft addendum (due EOD Wed)
- @MARTA billing matrix + invoice template
- @LEO update SE note for KMS upsell
- @sam_corp confirm PO text

sam_corp: Confirmed, we'll send PO by tomorrow morning. thx :thumbsup:
